_comment: Image prompt for one onboarding slide. Hand the 'prompt'
string to the image model; 'negative_prompt' and 'framing'
apply to every slide in this folder.
Slides come from the shipped flow in onboarding_sdk's
intro_page.dart - headline and caption_in_app are the copy
that sits ON the image, so the image must leave room for it
and must contain no text of its own.
audience: the learner setting up their own account
caption_in_app: Every lesson you attend is saved to rewatch any time - even between subscriptions.
intent: keeping what you earned; rewatching on your own terms
prompt: A South African teenager rewatching a lesson late, lying on a bed with a phone propped against a pillow, screen turned away from camera. One earphone in. A stack of exercise books and a school shirt on a chair nearby. Low warm lamplight, quiet and unhurried - the feeling of going back to something at your own pace rather than catching up in a panic. photorealistic documentary photograph, natural available light, real skin texture, candid and unposed, shot on a full-frame camera, 35mm, f/2.8, true-to-life colour.
negative_prompt: any text, letters, numbers, words, signage, logos, watermarks, user-interface elements, phone screens showing apps, charts or graphs, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, plastic sheen, cinematic colour grade, film still look, motion blur, lens flare, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted faces, stock-photo smiles, American classrooms, generic 'African' styling

framing.composition: subject in the lower two thirds, calm uncluttered space in the upper third where the slide's headline and caption sit - the image must never compete with the copy
framing.safe_area: keep the top 28% and bottom 18% visually quiet: the headline sits above, the button below

renditions_wanted.card_1080x1350: 4:5 crop for a card or a smaller surface
